title: 第十五章 为求灵药入黑山第十六章 幽林深处遇凶狼
content_zh:
石室里静得可怕，只有寒潭水滴落的“滴答”声，一下下敲在人心尖上。
楚夜躺在冰冷的石床上，后背的混沌道骨还在隐隐作痛，那是一种深入骨髓的虚弱感，比被楚彪打断骨头那次还要糟糕十倍。全身的经脉像是被无数烧红的铁钎捅过，丹田里空荡荡的，连一丝引气境该有的气感都提不起来。唯一能感觉到的，就是后背那块骨头还在微弱地搏动，像一颗疲惫的心脏，艰难地泵出丝丝缕缕温热的暖流，缓慢修复着这具几乎被打烂的身体。
“夜儿…喝点水…”柳氏的声音带着哭腔后的沙哑，小心翼翼地将一个粗糙的石碗凑到楚夜干裂的唇边。碗里的水带着一股浓重的土腥气。
楚夜费力地吞咽着，冰凉的水滑过火烧火燎的喉咙，带来一丝微弱的清明。他的目光越过母亲憔悴担忧的脸，死死盯向寒潭边那块黑石上的枯槁身影——楚家老祖，楚狂澜。
这老鬼，像块风干的树皮，无声无息地盘坐着，身上散发出的那股冰冷死寂的气息，比这寒渊密室的石头还要冷硬。混沌道骨在他体内发出一种近乎本能的、细微却持续不断的嗡鸣，充满了警惕和排斥！这感觉，比在黑风崖底面对那块诡异石壁时还要强烈！
“娘…”楚夜的声音嘶哑得如同砂纸摩擦，“他…为什么救我们？”
柳氏身体一颤，下意识地看了一眼老祖的方向，眼神里全是茫然和后怕，她压低声音，带着浓重的哭意：“娘…娘也不知道…老祖他…他就那么把我们带进来了…还…还清除了你身体里那…那东西…”她指的是那阴毒污秽的能量。
清除？楚夜心头冷笑。这老怪物出手，绝不是发善心！祠堂前的血腥，他绝对一清二楚！袖手旁观到最后关头才出手，现在又把自己这“孽障”带进禁地？图什么？除了自己脊梁骨里这块被污秽缠绕又被无形枷锁死死禁锢的混沌道骨，还有什么值得他这活死人觊觎的？
就在这时！
嗡——！
后背的混沌道骨毫无征兆地剧烈一震！一股比寒潭水更刺骨的冰冷恶意，如同潜伏在阴影里的毒蛇，猛地从石室某个角落——或者说，是从石室之外某个难以察觉的缝隙里——骤然探出！死死锁定了楚夜！
那股恶意贪婪、粘稠、带着毫不掩饰的垂涎！仿佛要将他连皮带骨，连同那块道骨一起吞噬！
楚夜全身的寒毛瞬间炸起！心脏像是被一只无形的手狠狠攥住，几乎窒息！这感觉…比被黑鳞暴猿的利爪按在地上时更恐怖百倍！是那个窥探者！它还在！而且就在附近！
冷汗瞬间浸透了他破烂的衣衫。这寒渊密室，根本不是什么避风港，是另一个更凶险的囚笼！一边是动机不明、如同活死人般的老祖，一边是阴魂不散、虎视眈眈的恐怖窥视！
“呃…”剧烈的情绪波动牵动了内伤，楚夜喉头一甜，一股腥气涌上。
“夜儿！”柳氏吓得魂飞魄散，手忙脚乱地想按住他，却又不敢用力。
就在这时，一直如同石雕般静坐的楚狂澜，喉咙里忽然发出一阵如同破旧风箱般的“嗬嗬”声，那双浑浊如同泥潭的眼睛，缓缓睁开了。冰冷的视线扫过石床上的楚夜和他焦急的母亲，最终落在柳氏苍白憔悴的脸上。
“你…旧伤沉疴…气血枯竭…”楚狂澜的声音干涩嘶哑，像是两块锈铁在摩擦，每一个字都带着冰冷的死气，没有任何情绪波动，如同在陈述一件与己无关的事实，“…活不过…一月。”
如同晴天霹雳！
柳氏身体猛地一晃，脸色瞬间惨白如纸，眼中刚刚燃起的一丝劫后余生的微光彻底熄灭，只剩下无尽的灰败和绝望。她张了张嘴，却发不出任何声音。

楚夜只觉得一股滔天的怒火混合着冰冷的恐惧瞬间冲上头顶！他挣扎着想坐起来，目眦欲裂地瞪着楚狂澜：“你…你胡说！”声音嘶哑破碎，却带着不顾一切的疯狂！
楚狂澜浑浊的眼珠转向他，那目光如同万载寒冰，冻得楚夜骨髓都在发冷：“…九死还魂草…黑山…阴风涧…”他枯槁的手指极其缓慢地抬起，指向石室一侧幽深曲折、不知通往何处的另一条黑暗甬道。“…三日…取回…或…死…”
冰冷的话语，如同最终宣判！
九死还魂草？黑山？阴风涧？
楚夜脑子里嗡的一声！黑山！那是荒域有名的凶地！外围就遍布凶兽毒虫，据说深处连引气境巅峰的高手都有进无出！阴风涧…更是听名字就让人头皮发麻的绝地！这老鬼…是要自己去送死？！
一股寒意从脚底板直冲天灵盖！原来如此！原来在这等着自己！他救自己，根本不是为了庇护！是为了让这块“废体”道骨，在彻底报废前，发挥最后一点价值——去那十死无生的绝地，为他取药！
楚夜牙齿咬得咯咯作响，指甲深深抠进坚硬的石床里，留下几道带血的印痕。愤怒、屈辱、不甘如同毒火灼烧着他的五脏六腑！这老怪物，根本没把他们母子的命当回事！母亲成了人质！自己成了探路的弃子！
“不…夜儿…不要去！”柳氏猛地扑到楚夜身上，泪水决堤般涌出，死死抱住他，仿佛一松手儿子就会消失，“娘没事！娘真的没事！不要听！不要去送死啊！”她宁愿自己立刻死了，也不要儿子再踏入那等绝境！
楚狂澜漠然地收回目光，仿佛没听到柳氏的哭喊，再次闭上了眼睛，如同融入了黑暗。那股冰冷的死寂威压弥漫开来，将柳氏的悲泣都压得低沉下去。
石室里只剩下柳氏压抑绝望的哭声和楚夜粗重如同破风箱般的喘息。
楚夜闭上眼，母亲的泪水滚烫地滴落在他脸上，灼烧着他的心。混沌道骨在虚弱中依旧顽强地搏动着，传递着微弱的暖流和一种…不屈的愤怒！
黑山…阴风涧…九死还魂草…
十死无生？
不！
他不能死在这里！更不能让母亲死！
祠堂前的血仇未报！天道枷锁的屈辱未雪！这老鬼和那阴影窥探者的账还没算！
混沌道骨…这是他唯一的依仗！崖底古洞的奇遇，引气三层震同门的力量，都是源于此！它能在黑风崖底护住自己，能在祠堂前硬抗污秽侵蚀，未必不能在黑山绝境中…搏出一条生路！
content_en:
It was eerily quiet in the stone chamber, with only the "tick-tock" sound of water dripping from the cold pool hitting the heart's apex.
Chu Ye was lying on the cold stone bed, and the Chaos Dao bones in his back were still aching faintly. It was a feeling of weakness that penetrated deep into the bone marrow. It was ten times worse than the time when Chu Biao broke his bones. The meridians all over the body seemed to have been stabbed with countless red-hot iron rods. The Dantian was empty, and there was not even a trace of Qi that should be felt in the Qi-entraining realm. The only thing that can be felt is that the bone in the back is still pulsing weakly, like a tired heart, struggling to pump out strands of warm current, slowly repairing the almost broken body.
"Ye'er... drink some water..." Liu's voice was hoarse after crying, and she carefully brought a rough stone bowl to Chu Ye's chapped lips. The water in the bowl had a strong earthy smell.
Chu Ye swallowed hard, and the cold water slid through his burning throat, bringing a faint sense of clarity. He looked past his mother's haggard and worried face and stared at the withered figure on the black stone beside the cold pool - the ancestor of the Chu family, Chu Kuanglan.
This old ghost looked like a piece of dried tree bark, sitting cross-legged silently. The cold, deathly aura exuding from his body was colder and harder than the stones in the cold abyss chamber. The Chaos Dao Bone made an almost instinctive, subtle but continuous hum in his body, full of vigilance and repulsion! This feeling is even stronger than when facing that strange stone wall at the bottom of Black Wind Cliff!
"Mother..." Chu Ye's voice was as hoarse as sandpaper, "Why...why did he save us?"
Mrs. Liu's body trembled, and she subconsciously glanced in the direction of the ancestor. Her eyes were full of confusion and fear. She lowered her voice, with a heavy cry: "Mother... I don't know... my ancestor... he just brought us in... and... he also removed that... thing from your body..." She was referring to the vicious and filthy energy.
Clear? Chu Ye sneered in his heart. This old monster is definitely not acting out of kindness! He was absolutely clear about the bloodshed in front of the ancestral hall! He stood by and watched until the last moment before taking action, and now he has brought his "evil obstacle" into the forbidden area? Picture what? Apart from this piece of chaotic bone in his spine that is entangled with filth and tightly imprisoned by invisible shackles, what else is worth coveting as a living dead?
Right now!
Buzz—!
The Chaos Dao Bone on the back shook violently without any warning! A cold malice that was more piercing than the cold pool water, like a poisonous snake lurking in the shadows, suddenly emerged from a corner of the stone chamber - or rather, from an imperceptible gap outside the stone chamber! Locked firmly on Chu Ye!
That malice is greedy, sticky, and unabashedly salivating! It seemed as if he was going to be swallowed up with his skin and bones together!
The hair all over Chu Ye's body suddenly exploded! My heart felt like it was being held tightly by an invisible hand, almost suffocating me! This feeling... is a hundred times more terrifying than being pinned to the ground by the sharp claws of the black-scaled ape! It's the snoop! It's still there! And it's nearby!
Cold sweat instantly soaked his tattered clothes. This Hanyuan secret room is not a safe haven at all, but another more dangerous prison! On one side is the ancestor with unknown motives, who is like a living dead, and on the other side is the terrifying peeping that lingers and stares eagerly!
"Uh..." The violent mood swings caused internal injuries. Chu Ye's throat felt sweet and a fishy smell surged up.
"Ye'er!" Mrs. Liu was so frightened that she frantically tried to hold him down, but she didn't dare to use any force.
At this moment, Chu Kuanglan, who had been sitting quietly like a stone sculpture, suddenly made a "ho-ho" sound like an old bellows from his throat, and his eyes that were as muddy as quagmire slowly opened. His cold gaze swept across Chu Ye and his anxious mother on the stone bed, and finally landed on Liu's pale and haggard face.
"You...are suffering from old wounds...depleted of energy and blood..." Chu Kuanglan's voice was dry and hoarse, like two pieces of rusty iron rubbing against each other, and every word was laced with...With a cold, dead air, without any emotion, it was as if he was stating a fact that had nothing to do with him, "...I won't survive...a month."
Like a bolt from the blue!
Liu's body swayed violently, and her face turned pale as a sheet. The glimmer of hope that had just ignited in her eyes was completely extinguished, leaving only endless defeat and despair. She opened her mouth, but no sound came out.
Chu Ye felt a surge of monstrous anger mixed with cold fear instantly rush to his head! He struggled to sit up and stared at Chu Kuanglan with splitting eyes: "You...you're talking nonsense!" His voice was hoarse and broken, but filled with desperate madness!
Chu Kuanglan's turbid eyes turned to him, and his gaze was like ice that had been frozen for thousands of years, chilling Chu Ye's bones: "...Nine Death Resurrection Grass...Black Mountain...Yinfeng Stream..." His withered fingers raised extremely slowly, pointing to another dark corridor on the side of the stone chamber that was deep and winding, leading to an unknown destination. "...Three days...to retrieve...or...die..."
The cold words are like the final sentence!
Nine-Death Resurrection Grass? Montenegro? Yinfengjian?
Chu Ye's mind buzzed! Montenegro! That is a famous dangerous place in the wilderness! The surrounding area is full of ferocious beasts and poisonous insects, and it is said that even masters at the peak of the Qi Entrainment Realm can't get in or out of the depths! Yinfengjian...is a Jedi whose name makes people's scalp numb! This old ghost...is he going to die on his own? !
A chill went straight from the soles of my feet to Tianling Gai! I see! It turned out to be waiting for me here! He didn't save himself for shelter at all! The purpose is to allow this piece of "wasted body" Taoist Bone to exert its last bit of value before it is completely scrapped - to go to that desperate Jedi place to get medicine for him!
Chu Ye gritted his teeth and dug his nails deeply into the hard stone bed, leaving several bloody marks. Anger, humiliation, and unwillingness were like poisonous fire burning his internal organs! This old monster didn't take the lives of their mother and son seriously at all! Mother has become a hostage! I have become an outcast exploring the path!
"No... Ye'er... don't go!" Madam Liu rushed to Chu Ye, tears welling up like a dam, and she hugged him tightly, as if her son would disappear if she let go, "Mom is fine! Mom is really fine! Don't listen! Don't go and die!" She would rather die immediately than let her son step into such a desperate situation again!
Chu Kuanglan looked away indifferently, as if he didn't hear Liu's cry, and closed his eyes again, as if he had melted into the darkness. The cold pressure of death spread, suppressing Liu's cries.
Only Liu's suppressed and desperate cries and Chu Ye's heavy breathing like a broken bellows were left in the stone room.
Chu Ye closed his eyes, and his mother's tears fell hotly on his face, burning his heart. The chaotic bones are still beating tenaciously despite their weakness, conveying a weak warmth and a kind of...unyielding anger!
Black Mountain...Yinfengjian...Nine Death Resurrection Grass...
Ten deaths and no life?
No!
He can't die here! Let alone let my mother die!
The blood feud in front of the ancestral hall has not been avenged! The humiliation of the yoke of heaven has not yet fallen! The old ghost and the shadow spy haven't settled their scores yet!
The Bone of Chaos...this is his only support! The adventure in the ancient cave at the bottom of the cliff, and the power to draw Qi to the third floor to shake the same sect, all come from this! It can protect itself at the bottom of the Black Wind Cliff, it can resist the erosion of filth in front of the ancestral hall, and it may not be able to fight for a way out in the desperate situation of Black Mountain!
